goal.background: A disconnected worker can recover after the same work package revision has been reassigned. Without a monotonically increasing fence, the stale worker can overwrite progress or register a candidate from an obsolete attempt.
goal.objective: Add transactionally allocated lease generations and reject every stale side-effecting Attempt operation without mutating authoritative state.
goal.value: At most one lease generation can affect acceptance and integration for a work package revision.

glossary.generation: A server-allocated monotonically increasing integer scoped to project_id, package_id and revision.
glossary.salvage: Read-only material retained from an expired attempt; it cannot enter automatic acceptance or integration.

assumptions: PostgreSQL is the authoritative lease store.
Client wall-clock time is not trusted.

requirements.text: Each successful reassignment of the same project_id, package_id and revision shall allocate a generation strictly greater than every previously committed generation.
Renew, checkpoint, artifact registration and Candidate registration operations shall atomically validate the active generation before applying their side effect.
requirements.error_semantics: A lower, superseded or revoked generation returns HTTP 409 with code AF_LEASE_STALE. A still-current lease whose server-time expiry has passed returns HTTP 410 with code AF_LEASE_EXPIRED. Both leave all domain tables and the outbox unchanged.

requirements.text: Replaying an accepted request with the same idempotency key and payload shall return the original response without duplicating domain rows or outbox events.
An expired attempt may register a content-addressed salvage bundle, but its submission shall be quarantined and shall not trigger verification or integration.

must_do: Allocate and validate generation in PostgreSQL transactions.
Apply fencing to renew, checkpoint, artifact and Candidate registration command handlers.
Add concurrent reassignment, stale-write, replay and salvage tests.
should_do: Keep the generation allocator isolated behind a repository interface for deterministic tests.
non_goals: Change executor matching or bounty calculation.
Allow workers to push directly to the protected integration branch.
invariants: Existing successful API response fields remain backward compatible.
Worker-provided timestamps never influence generation ordering.
A stale command produces no domain mutation and no outbox event.
The candidate, reviewed and reproduced Git heads are byte-identical.

interfaces.notes: Add AF_LEASE_STALE to the existing 409 error-code enum; do not remove or rename existing variants.

autonomous_decisions: Choose transaction isolation and locking details if all acceptance criteria and invariants remain true.
Add private helper types and tests inside allowed paths.
must_escalate: The existing Attempt store cannot provide a compare-and-set transaction boundary.
A required compatibility change would remove or rename a public API field.
The pinned baseline fails before any task change.

criteria.given: A PostgreSQL test instance and two workers claiming revision 3 in sequence.
criteria.when: Generation 4 is granted after generation 3, then both generations call renew, checkpoint, artifact and Candidate registration handlers.
criteria.then: All generation-4 calls succeed; every generation-3 call returns AF_LEASE_STALE; domain and outbox row counts show no stale write.

criteria.given: A valid active lease and generated sequences containing duplicate and reordered request deliveries.
criteria.when: At least 1000 seeded delivery sequences are applied to every fenced command handler.
criteria.then: Each idempotency key produces at most one domain mutation and one outbox event, and replay returns the recorded response.

criteria.given: An expired generation-3 attempt with a valid content-addressed bundle and an active generation-4 attempt.
criteria.when: The expired worker registers salvage and tries to register a normal Candidate.
criteria.then: The bundle is recorded as salvage, the submission is QUARANTINED, and no verification or integration event is emitted.

criteria.given: The immutable base and candidate commits.
criteria.when: The verifier lists all changed paths including renames and submodule entries.
criteria.then: Every changed path is allowed and no forbidden path is present.

criteria.given: A clean checkout of the candidate commit with the pinned Rust toolchain and Cargo.lock.
criteria.when: The complete workspace test suite is executed with network disabled after dependency hydration.
criteria.then: Compilation and all workspace tests complete successfully.

deliverables.description: Immutable candidate commit with required AgentForge trailers.
Signed per-criterion evidence and clean-reproduction manifest.

completion.rollback: Revert the integration merge commit. The migration may add generation state but shall not delete or rewrite existing attempt data.
definition_of_done: Every hard acceptance criterion is PASS.
There are no open critical or high review findings.
CandidateHead, ReviewedHead and TestedHead are identical.
The signed evidence bundle is registered.
The candidate is reproduced on the latest integration target before merge.
